asr.full_text: Hey guys welcome back to crypto clan today we'll be talking about massive news of XLM potentially being at the centre of FedNow developments so news has recently broken of the payment infrastructure FedNow being said to be rolled out by the Federal Reserve over the next few days. Where it's expected that FedNow is set launched in July, 2023. So, in view of the rolling down the FedNow payment infrastructure the Federal Reserve has actually come forward and news has been made that the Federal Reserve is potentially considering the utility of both XRP and XLM for blockchain integration into FedNow payment system. So this factor can be quite significant, especially in regards to the utility of both cryptocurrencies to improve the payment infrastructure associated with FedNow. So the following clip goes into further detail in regards to how the FedNow payment operating system will function and how the utility of this payment infrastructure will have reverberating effects across the wider financial sector within the U.S. We wanted to put that research out there, the benefits and opportunities of instant payments and also we are doing a lot of education about FedNow and the use cases we envision developing first. we will probably be surprised, there will be a lot of innovation now about Fennow we are not even thinking about it. I mean we designed the service with that in mind, it's a cloud-based service, high resilience. I think we're actually the first central bank that has developed a payment system fully in the cloud. So that's really exciting there and so we certainly leaned in to support that kind of innovation in the marketplace for the future. Which begs the question then, what is it going to mean for the U.S. payments landscape? Because you're absolutely correct, it is quite innovative for a central bank to involve itself in this way, but is that involvement likely to encourage even greater innovation on the landscape scene generally for payments? That's what we see. We think that FedNow, as a service, is going to dramatically change the payment landscape in the US. The availability of instant payments to over 10,000 institutions, that is absolutely a game changer. One of the reasons why we decided to build a new service for the first time in four years. So the innovation for the future, we're the flexibility that services is going to offer, we're really excited about the opportunities going forward. So as stated in the previous clip the FedNow payment infrastructure will bring about a number of benefits for the overarching US economy, most notably, the payment infrastructure will provide instantaneous payments, where a sender of payment will send a given value to a receiver at instantaneous rates and this will bring about a number of benefits for the overarching US economy where the ability to verify transactions and the ability for payments to be verified instantaneously will see the payment infrastructure within the u.s. to improve and the efficiency of payment systems become more viable and more functional for a number of financial bodies and even for individuals across the wider u.s. marketplace so what does this all mean for both XRP and Xlam so if the Federal Reserve choose to directly utilize both XRP and XLM into their blockchain Infrastructure part of the Fed now payment system. This could be a means of improving the enhancement in payment system and the ability for transactions to be validated seamlessly and instantaneously. Where XLM provides a number of innate qualities and benefits including its ability for the enabling or fast and cost effective transactions to be authorised and validated, coupled with facilitation of secure payment infrastructure across the wider US marketplace through again utilising the innate qualities and characteristics associated with the Stellar Network and XLM cryptocurrency. So the Stellar network in itself has a number of qualities which has led to a number of organizations and even nations actively utilizing the stellar network into their frameworks where seller provides the ability to enhance speed transparency and the security of financial transactions, be between businesses or even between individuals so extremely beneficial in regards to the active and direct utility of the seller network and indirectly the usage of the XLM cryptocurrency to verify such transactions. So the active utility and the provisioning of both XLM and the underlying sterling network will bring about a number of benefits in terms of enabling the payment infrastructures associated with FedNow to operate 24 7 and this will see improvements in the seamlessness of transactions between financial bodies whereas mentioned in the initial clip the FedNow payment infrastructure system is set to be utilized by over 10,000 financial bodies including banks across the US and it's expected that over 90% of businesses and financial institutions will eventually utilize FedNow into their frameworks. So if XLM and even XRP are directly incorporated into the blockchain branch of FedNow payment system this will see potentially increases in the utility of both cryptocurrencies and as a result the demand for both cryptocurrencies will increase. And this could see synonymous increases to the price of XLM and XRP respectively as time progresses and again if both are utilized into the payment infrastructure. But again time will tell in regards to whether both cryptocurrencies will be utilised into this initiative and development but extremely exciting and it only spells good news for XLM token holders and and for the wider crypto industry as a whole so extremely exciting and again the utility of both cryptocurrencies could be quite significant especially as the utility of both projects could see the direct incorporation of blockchain technology into traditional financial infrastructure. So we'll see the bridging between blockchain and DRT innovations with traditional financial systems and this will again go about indicating the importance and the revolutionary dynamics associated with both crypto DLT and blockchain innovations and technology. So the following clip goes into further detail in regards to how the payment settlement times associated with the verification of payments associated with FedNow will operate and the number of benefits these payment infrastructures will bring about for the wider community businesses and banking infrastructure data and monetization because there is now a move from before the classical payment which was only there to execute move money from A to B and oh by the way swift can take up to 14 days 10 workdays now now we talk about seconds milliseconds partially and we've done last year end of last year an interesting study together with oikon solutions and salad on that one and the interesting part was when you take look what people want and what the priorities of the clients guess what mobile domestic real-time cross-border real-time next generation web channels all of this stuff is what FedNow is about for the United States and so with FedNow being equipped with a number of key characteristics including its ability to enable and induce instantaneous payment protocols coupled with the prospective utilization of xlm in the underlying crypto branch of fed now payment system this could be quite significant for the price of xlm what are your thoughts on stella do you think the federal reserve will utilize xlm into fed now. let us know your views in the comments below. thank you for watching crypto clan. don't forget to like subscribe and click on the notification bell. let us know your views in the comments below thank you for watching and we'll see you in the next video. To be continued ...
